title: A Protocol for the Asset
author: Sable Yarrow
blurb: Theo Coldharbour, a whistle-blower living under four names, works cases no one wants attributed. Then the safe house is listed for sale — with photos of the inside — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must burn the network that did the training before the border checkpoint shifts change.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
